fusions.name: Clod Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Upheaval
fusions.desc: The ground heaves under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 14 damage and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Furrow Drive
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
